note: Fort McCoy Army MWR campground on Suukjak Sep Lake beside the La Crosse River, open to the public: its entrance is off Hwy 21 about 1.6 miles west of the Fort McCoy main gate, with no base gate to pass. Any firearm brought in must be registered with the Fort McCoy Police, and bugle calls sound through the day. Cabins, yurts and rental campers too; swimming beach, accessible fishing dock, paddle-boat and canoe rentals, mini golf and a disc golf course. --Claude
